summary.intent: Fix CodeRabbit's PR review being skipped due to too many files (265) by adding path filters to exclude generated/model files and bring the count under the 150-file threshold.
summary.outcome: Added broader path exclusions to .coderabbit.yaml (models, web api client, planning/learnings dirs) and pushed, but it was not confirmed whether CodeRabbit subsequently processed the PR correctly.

repo: cipher-box uses pnpm with a monorepo structure; build order must be sequential following the dependency chain: crypto → core → api-client → sdk-core → sdk → api → web
api-client contains ~102 generated model files under packages/api-client/src/models/ that should be excluded from code review
apps/web/src/api/ contains generated web client files
.planning/ and .learnings/ are documentation directories, not code

code.finding: Path filters using glob patterns like !packages/api-client/src/models/** may not take effect on the same commit that introduces them — CodeRabbit may evaluate file counts before applying newly added filters

workflow: CodeRabbit skips reviews when PR file count exceeds ~150 files; path filters in .coderabbit.yaml are the mechanism to exclude generated files
CodeRabbit reports the commit hash it processed — cross-referencing this against when config changes were introduced helps diagnose filter timing issues
Multiple --filter flags in a single pnpm build run packages in parallel, which can cause failures when packages have type declaration dependencies on each other

friction: CodeRabbit may not apply newly added path filters on the same commit that introduces them, creating a chicken-and-egg problem
Unclear whether the glob format !packages/api-client/src/models/** is valid in .coderabbit.yaml or needs adjustment
Had to manually count files by directory to understand why the file count was still 265 despite the models/ exclusion being present
open_items: Verify that CodeRabbit processes the PR correctly after the broader exclusion push and confirm file count drops below threshold
Confirm the correct glob syntax for path filters in .coderabbit.yaml — the models exclusion did not appear to work as expected
